newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan seven-day NCD average yield at 7.248 pct.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan seven-day NCD average yield at 7.248 pct.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank on Wednesday issued T$3 billion in seven-day negotiable certificates of deposit at a single yield of 7.248 percent.
The issue came on the same day as the maturation of T$3 billion NCDs issued earlier by the central bank.
Taiwan's money rates closed higher on Tuesday and rose at mid-session Wednesday amid tightening liquidity due to a booming stock market and depreciating Taiwan dollar.

Dealers said big turnover in the bourse was intensifying fund flows from the banking system, while the Taiwan dollar's tumble below T$28 to the U.S. dollar sparked concerns the central bank may intervene to support the currency.
The rate finished at T$28.17, its lowest in more than eight years, and was down to T$28.339 at mid-session on Wednesday.
